chemistry-killer-08.material: Cufnaanta xalka sodium hydroxide 20 % (boqolleyda cufka) ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, culeyska formula 40) waa 1.2 g/mL. Haddii xalkan biyo lagu qasiyo si loo sameeyo 600 mL oo 0.5 M NaOH ah, waa imisa mugga (mL) ee xalka 20 % NaOH ah ee loo baahan yahay? (Culeysyada atomiga H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x waa boqolleyda cufka, d waa cufnaanta xalka g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Cufnaanta xalka sodium hydroxide 20 % (boqolleyda cufka) ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, culeyska formula 40) waa 1.2 g/mL. Haddii xalkan biyo lagu qasiyo si loo sameeyo 600 mL oo 0.5 M NaOH ah, waa imisa mugga (mL) ee xalka 20 % NaOH ah ee loo baahan yahay? (Culeysyada atomiga H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x waa boqolleyda cufka, d waa cufnaanta xalka g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Molarity-ga NaOH 20 % $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (1 L = 1200 g xal, NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Tallaabo 2: Mole-ka walaxda lagu milmay ee xalka la rabo = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Tallaabo 3: Qasidda waxaa mole-ka walaxda lagu milmay joogto ah: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Hubin: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = 60 g xal, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Jawaab: 50 mL (d). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 60 mL waxaa lagu xisaabiyay iyadoo la iska indho tiray cufnaanta oo M = 5.0, 72 mL waxaa lagu dhuftay 60 g cufnaanta, 5.0 mL waa qalad meel-tobaneed.)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
